fields.description: Public IP for outbound mail. DNS, SPF and reverse DNS use it.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: The provider maps the public IP to a private one on the gateway (AWS, GCP, Azure), so the gateway sends from the private IP. Turn off when the public IP is configured on the gateway itself.
fields.label: Bind to Private IP

fields.description: The private IP the public IP is mapped to, configured on the gateway, e.g. 172.31.8.200.
fields.label: Private IP Address

fields.description: Set on save, e.g. p1-1.blr.frappemail.com. Reverse DNS of the address must point to it.
fields.label: EHLO Hostname

fields.description: Reverse DNS points to the EHLO hostname. Checked daily.
fields.label: PTR Verified
